explicit_validation.explanation: The paper explicitly conducts correlation analysis between GPT-4 evaluation and human judgment for both faithfulness and coverage metrics, reporting quantitative correlation results.

prompts.notes: Full prompts for various evaluation protocols (binary grading, Likert scale grading, pairwise comparison) are shown in appendix figures with detailed scoring rubrics

guidelines.notes: Detailed annotation guidelines provided in appendix with examples of valid/invalid annotations for faithfulness and coverage evaluation

sample_size.notes: Validation conducted on a subset of the 245 news story clusters, exact sample size not specified

quantitative_scores.notes: Both-way pairwise comparison protocol shows high correlation with human judgment
Both coarse-grained (QA-pairs) and fine-grained (single QA) evaluation protocols show reasonably high correlation with human judgments

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4 evaluation shows high correlation with human judgment for both faithfulness and coverage assessment, though specific correlation coefficients are not numerically reported.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation methods assess the same two criteria: faithfulness (factual consistency with source articles) and coverage (inclusiveness of diverse information)
